description: Save Telegram drafts, inspect an interactive post card, edit working content, schedule publications and update or delete selected messages in connected channels and groups. Continue with the same posts in Telegram or a browser. Free Beta includes 5 destinations, 30 publications per day, 300 per 30 days and 1 GB of media; published posts include mandatory Postlyra attribution. No built-in AI generation or subscriptions are offered.

defaultPrompt: Find my latest Telegram draft and show its interactive Postlyra card.
Save the post we wrote in this chat as a Telegram draft.
Show my Telegram publication schedule for the next seven days.
